# Global Football System Integration, Orchestration & Observability Contract v0.1

Production nervous system for the global football decision-intelligence platform.

`Events -> Orchestration -> Contracts -> Intelligence -> Decisions -> Risk -> Truth -> Learning`

Reliability is achieved through idempotency, bounded retries, dead-letter queues, circuit breakers,
backpressure, immutable stage runs, end-to-end tracing, SLOs, and safe replay.
